findings.message: Vague pronoun 'it' starts a clause. Name the thing it refers to.
INFER needs a confidence level: [INFER:HIGH], [INFER:MEDIUM] or [INFER:LOW].
FACT does not cite a source with [src:...].
Passive voice ('was updated') hides the actor.
FACT does not cite a source with [src:...].
